content.text:
I've submitted index 23 (Sb fraction 0.794) as the best composition. It gave the highest EQE of the five I measured: 0.042%.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 7 | 0.28 | −0.012 |
| 13 | 0.49 | 0.0016 |
| 18 | 0.62 | 0.014 |
| 23 | 0.79 | **0.042** |
| 26 | 0.855 | 0.023 |

EQE rose steadily as Sb increased, then fell at 0.855. So the peak is probably somewhere around Sb 0.75–0.82. I didn't measure the neighbours of index 23 (indices 21, 22, 24 and 25), and one of them could beat it. Only compositions I actually measured count toward the score, and the EQE budget is now used up, so that can't be checked.

I also didn't use any of the 5 XRD measurements. That means I can't say which crystal phase is behind the peak. My guess is a rutile-type Sb-rich phase, but that's unconfirmed.
